# Fenrir Vulnerability Manager

Find, rank and fix vulnerabilities, and prove they are fixed. For teams who need a risk-ranked view of missing patches and vulnerable software, external exposure and breached credentials.

Fenrir Vulnerability Manager is one of the [Fenrir apps](../README.md): it runs on its own, with its own dashboard, from this
repository with `FENRIR_APP=vuln`. It is free, self-hosted and released under the Apache License 2.0, as-is and
without support.

## What it does

- Agent-based scanning: missing Windows security updates, vulnerable installed programs (NVD) and Linux packages (OSV.dev)
- Risk ranking from CVSS, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities, EPSS exploit probability and device criticality
- Per-CVE pages with evidence, the fix (KB or version) and an install button
- Verified remediation: a fix counts only when the next scan confirms it
- Automatic remediation for supported fixes, with approvals
- External attack-surface scans of the IPs and hostnames you own
- Dark-web breached-credential monitoring and sensitive-data discovery on devices
- Live compliance posture (Cyber Essentials, CIS v8, NIST CSF 2.0, Essential Eight, ISO 27001) from real evidence

## Quick start

1. Fork this repository (or copy it into a private repository) and clone **your** copy onto a Linux server.
2. Point a domain name such as `vuln.yourcompany.com` at the server.
3. Run setup and choose this app:

   ```bash
   deploy/setup.sh --app vuln
   ```

   Setup asks for your domain, an administrator email and your organisation's name, writes `deploy/.env` with fresh
   secrets, and can build and start the server.
4. Open `https://vuln.yourcompany.com` and sign in with the email and the password setup printed.

The [full guide](GUIDE.md) covers every step in detail, first use, each page, configuration, updates, backups and
troubleshooting.

## The dashboard

| Menu | Page | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| Home | **Dashboard** | The app's headline numbers and a way into each of its pages. |
| Endpoints | **Devices** | Every enrolled device. Open one for its health, system details, software, activity, remote session and effective policy. |
| Endpoints | **Device groups** | Organise each customer's devices, give groups their own policy, and target them with actions. |
| Endpoints | **Protection policies** | What agents do: scanning, real-time protection, DNS filtering, monitoring, updates, phone rules. One default per customer, overridable per group. |
| Endpoints | **Agent health** | Whether each agent is on the current build (and why not), and what it reported failing in the last 7 days. |
| Endpoints | **Vulnerabilities** | Missing Windows security updates, vulnerable programs (NVD) and Linux packages (OSV.dev), ranked by CVSS, CISA KEV, EPSS and device criticality. Fixes are confirmed by the next scan. |
| Endpoints | **Deploy agents** | Choose an operating system and customer, then download an installer that enrols itself. |
| Identity, cloud & network | **Data & identity exposure** | Breached credentials (dark-web monitoring) and sensitive data found on devices. |
| Identity, cloud & network | **Attack surface** | Scan the internet-facing IPs and hostnames you own for exposed RDP, SMB, databases, weak TLS and expiring certificates. |
| Admin | **Settings** | Customers (tenants), users and roles, custom fields, region and holidays, webhooks, API credentials, approvals, the audit log and platform options. |

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Server | Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS on amd64 recommended), 4 vCPUs, 8 GB RAM plus 4 GB swap, 80 GB SSD. 16 GB RAM makes the first build faster. |
| Software | Docker Engine with buildx and Docker Compose 2.24.4 or newer, Git, curl, OpenSSL, Bash, Python 3. |
| Network | A domain name (DNS A record) pointing at the server; TCP 80 and 443 open; SSH restricted to you. Devices must reach the server over HTTPS. |
| Signing (optional) | A Windows code-signing certificate (.pfx). Without one, Windows agents are built unsigned and SmartScreen warns. |

## Not in this app

Patch rollout with rings and maintenance windows (the **rmm** app), antivirus (**av**), tickets (**psa**). Without the PSA, "open a remediation ticket" is not offered and automatic tickets are skipped; each finding's own history is the record. To add another app later, switch to `FENRIR_APP=complete` (see [the guide](GUIDE.md#adding-more-apps-later)); your data is kept.
